t: This is Evelyn Grace Academy, a non-selective, coeducational secondary school in Brixton, in the London borough of Lambeth. It was designed by Zaha Hadid, an Iraqi British architect who was born in Baghdad and studied mathematics before enrolling at the Architectural Association in 1972. She is recognised as a key figure in the architecture of the late twentieth and early twenty-first centuries. Looking for an alternative to traditional architectural drawing, she adopted painting as a design tool. So this school carries the hand of an architect regarded as central to her time.
